record.source_episode: Approved KSU tools context; user-approved version-scoped repair policy and executed upgrade feedback
record.trigger: A requirement fails with the selected tool version or dependency environment.
record.principle: Diagnose modeling, implementation, environment and genuine tool expressiveness failures separately. Review documented alternative encodings and execute capability probes. Defer an exact English obligation only after reviewed evidence establishes that the selected version cannot support it; retain it for later upgrade, give no passing credit, and invalidate the exclusion when the tool changes.
record.semantic_choice: A syntax rejection is not proof that equivalent state-based formalization is unavailable. A periodic scheduling mismatch is not an unsupported temporal requirement.
record.structural_placement: Version-bound capability scope attached to exact approved English and validation configuration; preserve original coverage and evidence.
record.repair_gate: Review exact English, executed tool identity, alternative encodings and evidence; approve scope separately; revalidate after upgrade. Passing remaining targets does not imply whole-system acceptance.
exclusions: Treating solver runtime incompatibility as unsupported English

counterexample.scenario: Bundled Z3 cannot run on host glibc, while the documented CVC5 backend verifies the same integration constraints.
counterexample.expected_difference: Select the supported working backend; do not waive the English requirement.

record.notes: Session-curated unvalidated draft. Approved KSU context supplies tool-workflow provenance; user policy and new executed development feedback supply this proposed refinement. Tutorial fixture is not added to training. No paid model call or release approval.

misleading_near_matches: the golden lacks a contract so the requirement is unsupported
